title: GTA 6 Khelne Se Pehle Yeh 3 Secrets Jaan Lo! 😱🔥 #shorts #gta6
description:
GTA 6 ke 3 sabse bade hidden secrets jo har gamer ko pata hone chahiye! Map size, realistic water physics aur smart police AI.

#shorts #gta6 #gta6secrets #gaminghindi #hindishorts #viralshorts
script: GTA 6 khelne se pehle yeh teen secrets jaan lo warna bahut kuch miss kar doge! Number ek, is game ka map GTA 5 se do guna bada hai aur ismein sattar percent se zyada buildings ke andar aap ja sakte ho. Number do, game ki water physics aur dynamic weather system itna real hai ki baarish ke baad sadkon par paani jama hota hai aur dhoop nikalne par sookhta bhi hai. Aur number teen, NPCs ab aapke chehre aur gaadi ko yaad rakhte hain, matlab ek baar crime kiya toh police aapko pehchaan legi! Kya aapne GTA 6 khela ya nahi, comment mein zaroor batao!
